Lina: Heads-up: noticed duplicate confirmed tokens coming from a canary when a truncated stream retried across regions. Pattern looks slightly different than previous tickets.
Omar: how so? paste a tiny trace snippet.
Lina: sanitized: 
[2026-03-25T14:05:12Z] req=qa-77 route=us-east-1 client_session=cs-22 toolcall_id=tc-7 truncated_at=1024 provisional=1050
[2026-03-25T14:05:16Z] client retried -> routed to eu-west-1 req=qa-77 client_session=cs-22 toolcall_id=tc-7 provisional=1050
[2026-03-25T14:05:22Z] ledger: both provisional->confirmed; billed 2100 tokens
Lina: difference: retry arrived with same toolcall_id but different routing tag, both branches confirmed independently and ledger credited twice.
Rhea: that suggests our dedupe is toolcall_id-scoped but combined with route-scoped ledgers; confirmation commits happen per-region without global coordination. Race: two commits both observe a draft and confirm locally.
Omar: interesting. Previously cases were missing toolcall_id. This is a commit-window race.
Lina: yes. Two remediation vectors: (A) make ledger commit idempotent globally (centralized finalization or cross-region lease), or (B) change routing to prefer session affinity to the origin route for retries to avoid multi-commit paths.
Rhea: global commit fixes correctness but is invasive/latencyy. Session affinity is less invasive but is best-effort and fails on region outages. Maybe combine: session affinity + a short global commit reconciliation step before finalizing charges.
Omar: UX/telemetry: we should tag provisional allocations with origin_route + finalizer_route + commit_token and emit a commit_conflict metric when same toolcall_id confirmed from different finalizer_route. Console could show a "commit conflicts" card with per-tenant examples and an opt-in button to run automated reconciles/refunds.
Lina: Ops mitigation: add an alert for any spike in commit_conflict_rate > 0.01% over baseline and run a reconciliation job that looks for same toolcall_id confirmed multiple times within 120s.
Rhea: For implementation: I can prototype a lightweight cross-region finalizer that uses a short-lived coordinator (raftless) in the control plane to obtain a single-commit lease for a toolcall_id. If lease acquired, region can finalize; otherwise region must skip finalization and mark for reconcile.
Omar: alternative lighter change: extend provisional TTL slightly and delay finalization by 1-2s to give a chance for cross-region canonicalization. Tradeoff: small latency increase for commit stability.
Lina: let's do both as staged plan: 1) immediate: add commit_conflict metric + reconciliation job + dashboard card; 2) short-term canary: session-affinity for retries (routing change); 3) medium-term: implement short global finalizer (lease) or 2s commit delay and measure.
Rhea: I'll open a design doc for the finalizer and prototype a 2s delayed-commit mode behind a flag.
Omar: I'll add the dashboard card and the alert. Lina, please open the billing ticket for reconcile and link this thread.
buildbot: created BLG-2026-105 (auto)
Lina: thanks. Owners: Rhea -> finalizer design + prototype; Omar -> telemetry + alerts + dashboard; Lina -> billing liaison + reconcile job. We'll sync next week and re-assess before the canary rollout.
